rust_summary: a pickup click before item stack overrides (`native_item_stacked_on_other`).
doc_summary: a pickup click before the item overrides, on both sides: `native_item_stacked_on_other(event, canceled)` gets the logical side, player entity id and UUID, menu slot, backing container and slot indices, the button, a carried-stack access and a clicked-slot view. The view checks slot rules and moves items through safe insertion and removal, including result-slot take behavior. Canceling skips the overrides (a bundle's); `cancellation_result` then says whether the rest of the click is skipped too. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:item_stacked_on_other@`.
